name: Mixed Add-On Playground
description: A Runner with its own HUD and a Pulse Carbine, a Dune Buggy, Blockhead Bots, Stompers and Fizzers, all from separate Add-Ons. Build a fort, drive through it, fight the bots. Type /trooper to become the heavy Trooper with its own camera, /blockhead for a plain Blockhead, or /body to pick any body the game allows. You respawn as the body you picked.
